_readme: The Barred Gate moves exactly like the demo, and this is the assertion that says so.
It exists because it did not, and a player found out before any gate did. The second
game shipped with allow_diagonal = false in a config of its own - a deliberate choice,
made on the player's behalf, buried in a file comment. Seven scripted play sessions all
passed, because every one of them holds a single direction at a time.
So: hold two directions at once and require BOTH axes to move. With diagonals off the
dominant axis wins and ties go horizontal, which means y would sit perfectly still -
and that is exactly what this catches.

steps.text: the warden opens the game now - hear her out before anything else
south-east across open ground: both keys down together
and back north-west, so it is not one lucky direction
